item.title: Ex-lawmaker jailed for 12.5 years in Macao's first national security case
item.description:
Published: 2026-11-07
MACAO, Nov. 6 (Xinhua) -- Au Kam San, a former lawmaker in China's Macao Special Administrative Region (SAR), was sentenced to 12 years and six months in prison on Friday in the SAR's first national security case.
The Court of First Instance found Au guilty of subversion of state power, establishing links with organizations outside Macao to endanger national security, and breaching confidentiality, according to a court statement.
Hearings were held on Sept. 16 and 18. Au did not dispute most of the proven facts underlying the charges and acknowledged that his collusion with several external organizations constituted criminal conduct, the court said.
Friday's verdict was announced publicly, with members of the public, journalists and Au's family attending.

item.title: Chinese premier holds talks with Austrian chancellor
item.description:
Published: 2026-11-07
Chinese Premier Li Qiang holds talks with Austrian Chancellor Christian Stocker, who is on an official visit to China, at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, capital of China, Nov. 6, 2026. (Xinhua/Ding Haitao)
BEIJING, Nov. 6 (Xinhua) -- Chinese Premier Li Qiang held talks in Beijing on Friday with Austrian Chancellor Christian Stocker, who is on an official visit to China.
Noting this year marks the 55th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and Austria, Li said that over the past half a century or so, the two sides have upheld mutual respect, mutual trust, open cooperation and win-win results, promoting the sustained development of bilateral relations and achieving fruitful cooperative results.
As supporters and beneficiaries of multilateralism and free trade, China and Austria should resolutely advance open cooperation to galvanize their respective development and inject positive energy into the world economy, Li said. China is willing to strengthen dialogue and communication with Austria, consolidate political mutual trust, respect each other's core interests and major concerns, expand all-round cooperation, and bring more tangible benefits to the people of both countries, Li added.
He said China stands ready to share more market opportunities with Austria, import more high-quality Austrian goods, and foster the expansion and upgrading of bilateral trade. The premier also called on both sides to expand cooperation in areas such as new energy, artificial intelligence, digital economy and advanced manufacturing.
China supports more Chinese enterprises investing in Austria, and hopes Austria will provide them with a fair, just and non-discriminatory business environment, Li said.
Both sides should strengthen exchanges and cooperation in such fields as culture, tourism and education, strengthen two-way personnel exchanges, and constantly enhance mutual understanding and friendship, he said.
It is hoped that Austria, as a member state of the European Union, will continue to play an active role in promoting the European side to adhere to a rational and pragmatic policy towards China, Li said, adding China is willing to enhance cooperation with Austria in multilateral fields such as the United Nations (UN) to jointly promote world peace and prosperity.
Noting China is one of Austria's most important trading partners, Stocker said that under the current complex and volatile international situation, Austria is committed to promoting the friendly strategic partnership between the two countries and is willing to enhance mutual understanding with China, deepen practical cooperation in fields such as economy and trade, artificial intelligence, investment, tourism and culture, and strengthen communication and coordination on multilateral platforms such as the UN.
After their talks, the two leaders witnessed the signing of documents on cooperation in economy and trade, social security and other areas.

item.title: Chinese premier meets Gabonese president
item.description:
Published: 2026-11-07
Chinese Premier Li Qiang meets with Gabonese President Brice Clotaire Oligui Nguema, who is on a state visit to China, at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, capital of China, Nov. 6, 2026. (Xinhua/Huang Jingwen)
BEIJING, Nov. 6 (Xinhua) -- Chinese Premier Li Qiang met with Gabonese President Brice Clotaire Oligui Nguema, who is on a state visit to China, in Beijing on Friday.
Li said that since the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and Gabon, bilateral relations have continuously reached new heights, mutually beneficial cooperation has achieved new results, and traditional friendship has remained strong over time.
He said China is willing to work with Gabon to further consolidate political mutual trust, deepen practical cooperation, continuously enrich the connotation of the China-Gabon comprehensive strategic cooperative partnership, and bring more benefits to the people of the two countries.
China stands ready to deepen cooperation with Gabon in traditional fields such as mining, infrastructure, agriculture, forestry and fishery, actively carry out cooperation in emerging fields, including the digital economy and artificial intelligence, and create further growth drivers to better promote common development, Li said.
China is willing to import more quality products from Gabon and support more Chinese enterprises in investing and starting businesses in Gabon, Li added.
Li also called for strengthened bilateral cooperation in areas such as youth, culture, tourism, health care, and localities, noting that China firmly supports Africa's unity and self-strengthening, and is willing to enhance multilateral coordination and cooperation with Gabon and other African countries.
Nguema congratulated China on the successful convening of the fifth plenary session of the 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, noting that Gabon firmly adheres to the one-China principle, and supports the vision of building a community with a shared future for humanity and the four global initiatives proposed by China.
Nguema said China is Gabon's sincere and reliable development partner, adding that Gabon highly appreciates China's "zero-tariff" policy. He said his country is willing to deepen practical cooperation with China in areas such as mining, transportation, energy, fishery, forestry and artificial intelligence, expand people-to-people and cultural exchanges such as youth training, strengthen multilateral collaboration, and promote better development of Africa-China relations.

item.title: China passes law against cross-border corruption, ratifies agreement on establishing World AI Cooperation Organization
item.description:
Published: 2026-11-07
Zhao Leji, chairman of the National People's Congress (NPC) Standing Committee, presides over the closing meeting of the 25th session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, capital of China, Nov. 6, 2026. (Xinhua/Zhang Ling)
BEIJING, Nov. 6 (Xinhua) -- Chinese lawmakers on Friday voted to adopt a law against cross-border corruption, a law on procuratorial public-interest litigation, and ratify an agreement on establishing the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization.
The votes were taken at a closing meeting of the 25th session of the Standing Committee of the 14th National People's Congress (NPC) in Beijing.
Lawmakers also voted to adopt a law on Antarctic activities and environmental protection, a revised Water Law, and a decision on amending 15 laws, including the Emergency Response Law.
They also adopted a decision to remove Li Lecheng from the post of minister of industry and information technology.
President Xi Jinping signed five presidential orders to promulgate the laws and the decision, and a sixth one to announce the decision on the personnel change.
Zhao Leji, chairman of the NPC Standing Committee, presided over the closing meeting.
The meeting also voted to adopt reports on the examination of deputies' proposals and on the qualification of certain deputies and other personnel-related bills.
Addressing the closing meeting, Zhao stressed the need to uphold higher standards and adopt more concrete measures to improve the efficacy of Party building within the people's congress system, while urging further improvements to the legal framework for combating corruption.
He also chaired a meeting of the Council of Chairpersons of the NPC Standing Committee before the closing meeting, and presided over a lecture for lawmakers afterward.

item.title: Xi says a growing China can be partner to help Europe tackle challenges
item.description:
Published: 2026-11-07
Chinese President Xi Jinping meets with Austrian Chancellor Christian Stocker, who is on an official visit to China, at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, capital of China, Nov. 6, 2026. (Xinhua/Yin Bogu)
BEIJING, Nov. 6 (Xinhua) -- A growing and developing China is not the source of Europe's problems, but a partner that can help Europe address its challenges, said Chinese President Xi Jinping during his meeting with Austrian Chancellor Christian Stocker in Beijing on Friday.
Xi stressed that China and Europe should focus on areas of cooperation, resolve economic and trade frictions through dialogue and consultation, and achieve win-win results and common development.
Noting that this year marks the 55th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and Austria, Xi said trust and friendship are the valuable features of China-Austria relations, transcending differences in social systems, history, culture and development stages.
He called on the two sides to consolidate political mutual trust, sustain the positive momentum of high-level exchanges, enhance mutual trust and dispel misgivings through communication, and lay a solid political foundation for future cooperation.
Xi said that during the 15th Five-Year Plan (2026-2030) period, China will foster emerging industries, upgrade traditional industries, and further expand opening-up, with a focus on the service sector. China Opportunity 2.0 will bring not only market dividends but also innovation dividends, he noted.
China stands ready to work with Austria to expand practical cooperation in emerging fields such as new-energy vehicles, artificial intelligence, digital economy and green development, and foster new engines for economic and trade growth, Xi said.
Noting that China-Austria friendship enjoys extensive public support, Xi said the two sides should expand people-to-people and cultural exchanges, facilitate personnel flows, and bring the peoples of the two countries even closer.
Stocker said that Austria is committed to fostering its friendly strategic partnership with China, and adheres to the one-China policy.
Stocker called on the two countries to build on the long-standing cooperation and mutual trust to comprehensively strengthen cooperation in trade, investment, science and technology, innovation and other fields, boost cultural, tourism and other people-to-people exchanges, and elevate bilateral relations to new heights.
He said Austria actively supports the development of EU-China relations and hopes both sides can resolve economic and trade differences through candid dialogue and consultation.
Austria is ready to work with China to uphold multilateralism, strengthen multilateral coordination, advance sustainable development, tackle challenges including climate change, and safeguard global prosperity and stability, added Stocker.

item.title: China, Gabon elevate ties to community with shared future for new era
item.description:
Published: 2026-11-07
Chinese President Xi Jinping holds talks with Gabonese President Brice Clotaire Oligui Nguema, who is on a state visit to China, at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, capital of China, Nov. 6, 2026. (Xinhua/Li Xiang)
BEIJING, Nov. 6 (Xinhua) -- Chinese President Xi Jinping held talks with Gabonese President Brice Clotaire Oligui Nguema in Beijing on Friday.
The two leaders announced the elevation of bilateral relations to a China-Gabon community with a shared future for the new era.
Noting China is willing to be a reliable friend and partner for Gabon in its independent development, Xi said China supports Gabon in maintaining independence in political, economic and diplomatic affairs, and will join hands with Gabon to build a China-Gabon community with a shared future for the new era.
Xi said China is ready to work with Gabon to maintain close communication at all levels, exchange experience in political party and state governance, and support Gabon in strengthening its governance capacity.
Hailing the strong economic complementarity and great potential for cooperation between the two countries, Xi called on both sides to strengthen the alignment of their development strategies and cultivate new growth drivers for cooperation.
He called for making good use of the new opportunities presented by zero-tariff treatment of African goods and the "green channel" facilitation measures for African agricultural and food products exported to China.
Both sides should expand and upgrade bilateral trade and investment cooperation to support Gabon's industrial development, job creation, and livelihood improvement, thereby enhancing the country's capacity for independent economic development, Xi said.
"The vision of building a community with a shared future for humanity and the four major global initiatives I have proposed serve, first and foremost, the common interests of the Global South and African countries," Xi said, adding that China supports Gabon in playing a greater role in international and regional affairs.
Nguema said Gabon firmly adheres to the one-China principle, and hopes to draw on China's successful experience in governance of party and country.
He said Gabon stands ready to further deepen practical cooperation with China, and welcomes more Chinese enterprises to invest and do business in Gabon to help Gabon achieve industrialization and sustainable development.
Noting that China has established a mutually beneficial and win-win partnership with Africa, Nguema said the zero-tariff policy meets the needs of African countries, enabling African products to enter the vast Chinese market, which is of historic significance to the development of African countries.
He added Gabon is willing to work with China to enhance solidarity and cooperation between Africa and China and jointly safeguard the interests of Global South countries.
After the talks, the two heads of state witnessed the signing of multiple cooperation documents covering the implementation of the Global Security Initiative, zero-tariff treatment, industrial and supply chains, Chinese language education, and other fields.
During Nguema's state visit to China, the two sides issued a joint statement on building a China-Gabon community with a shared future for the new era.
Prior to the talks, Xi held a welcome ceremony for Nguema in the Great Hall of the People. Xi also held a welcome banquet for him in the evening.

item.title: Xi votes in local legislative election in Beijing
item.description:
Published: 2026-11-07
Chinese President Xi Jinping, also general secretary of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and chairman of the Central Military Commission, casts his ballot to elect deputies to the Xicheng district people's congress at the Huairentang polling station of the Zhongnanhai electoral district in Xicheng District of Beijing, capital of China, Nov. 6, 2026. (Xinhua/Xie Huanchi)
BEIJING, Nov. 6 (Xinhua) -- Chinese President Xi Jinping cast his ballot at a polling station in Beijing on Friday to elect deputies to a local people's congress.
Xi, also general secretary of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and chairman of the Central Military Commission, voted at the Huairentang polling station of the Zhongnanhai electoral district in Xicheng District to elect deputies to the Xicheng district people's congress.
Xi stressed efforts to practice whole-process people's democracy, uphold Party leadership, and strengthen oversight throughout the election process to ensure that deputies who meet the people's expectations are elected.
Around 3:30 p.m. Friday, Xi arrived at the polling station, gave his voter registration card to staff for verification, and got a ballot. He cast his ballot after filling it.
Noting that the election of deputies to people's congresses is an important foundation for upholding, improving and practicing the people's congress system, Xi underlined the need to give full play to democracy, strictly act in accordance with the law, and ensure that the election is carried out fairly and cleanly.
On Friday afternoon, other senior Chinese leaders Li Qiang, Zhao Leji, Wang Huning, Cai Qi, Ding Xuexiang and Li Xi cast their ballots in person, while Han Zheng entrusted a staff member to vote on his behalf.
Former Chinese leader Hu Jintao also entrusted a staff member to vote on his behalf.
Friday saw people vote at 13,054 polling stations across Beijing to elect 4,898 new deputies to the people's congresses at the district level and 11,137 deputies to the township-level people's congresses.

item.title: How China is rebuilding 3,000-year-old bronze treasures
item.description:
Published: 2026-11-05
How do you put ancient treasures back together after thousands of years? At China's Sanxingdui archaeological site, conservators combine meticulous hands-on restoration with 3D scanning and digital modeling to study broken bronze artifacts and help reveal the extraordinary craftsmanship of ancient Shu civilization.
